item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Dara - Bangaranga (Eurovision) - Single (ALAC Lossless)
item.description: I'm wanting the Eurovision version of Dara's Bangaranga single in ALAC lossless. The version included on the Eurovision 2026 album isn't actually the Eurovision version of the song strangely enough, the "(Eurovision)" version is the actual finalised version of the track that she performed at Eurovision. The track is labeled "Bangaranga (Eurovision)" instead of just "Bangaranga". Would be greatly appreciated
item.author: AndrewShaw19
